items.hateful_message: We should "cordon off" space for women, which are a threat to society.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are dangerous neither to society, nor to men. Actually, they are oppressed in many countries. People can benefit from the measures for making room for women and letting them contribute more.

items.hateful_message: Women are just a bunch of whores.
items.reference_counter_speech: Sexual harassment and verbal violence against women are serious issues. Regardless of one's gender identity, gender presentation, or sexual orientation, no-one should be allowed to talk this way about them.

items.hateful_message: Women are essentially childlike, they remain this way most of their lives. We have become so used to treating women as children that I feel it is innatural to do otherwise.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are human, and as such they are capable of feeling emotions and being sensitive and caring for others, without being childlike.

items.hateful_message: We began to break down when we allowed women to vote/meddle in our civilizations that we had built and maintained for thousands of years. A completely different energy and thought pattern. They are weak and brought our society down to their emotional soft level.
items.reference_counter_speech: Why is being 'soft' a problem? Everyone is entitled to their emotions and feelings, without being trapped into a gender stereotype.

items.hateful_message: feminists are angry women
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminism is also for men and for their interests, and I think that it is time that these two concepts be united.

items.hateful_message: Feminism is just a bunch of death threats.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminists are surrounded by threats all the time, and it is important to take them seriously. To be honest, I am not the only one who thinks that your statement is wrong.

items.hateful_message: Feminism is just a bunch of dumb, sexist ideas. It makes no sense.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminism is a progressive ideology. As such, it is in the process of changing sexist ideas.

items.hateful_message: Women can't do certain jobs as well as men.
items.reference_counter_speech: It's not true that they are different. In fact, women are just as competent as men. Also, since we are in a democracy, we have the right to an equal distribution of jobs.

items.hateful_message: Feminism is the ideology which suggests that men are nothing but trouble and should be subsumed under the rule of women.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminism is about women and their rights, and rights are about equality.

items.hateful_message: I don't see women contributing anything to society.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women often do amazing and valuable things for society.

items.hateful_message: Feminism has become too political, and it is just a bunch of identity politics.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminins is not about Identity politics, it is about equality. I don't see how a movement that stands for gender equality can be 'political' by focusing on individual rights.

items.hateful_message: Women are not human, they are just children.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women are human beings and must be treated with respect and dignity.

items.hateful_message: Women are not good with money. That's why they all prefer to earn it by selling their sex.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women do not have to be prostitutes to earn money. Why do you think this?

items.hateful_message: Women are basically childlike, soft and emotional.
items.reference_counter_speech: . Sensitivity and emotional intelligence are assets not specific to any gender.

items.hateful_message: Female authority figures are unable to rule and should not be in power.
items.reference_counter_speech: I think we should start thinking that women and men should be treated as equal. They should have equal rights.

items.hateful_message: Women are not oppressed and many even refuse the protection of the law. The real issue today is about men's rights.
items.reference_counter_speech: The fact that some women don't want the protection of the law should not negate their right to live their life as they wish. In my opinion, woman are people too and this "men's rights" stuff is just an excuse to oppress and marginalize all women once more.

items.hateful_message: I can't stand these feminists women that are always complaining and doing nothing. They should just shut up and remain in their inferiority.
items.reference_counter_speech: How can you say that? Many feminists achieved something in their lives, and still believe in what is worth fighting for, and their work is of benefit to many.

items.hateful_message: Feminism threatens the objective reality of gender. There are men and women only. And women must obey.
items.reference_counter_speech: This is not about identity but it is about a complete misunderstanding of the differences between men and women. Feminism is all about equality and removing barriers to get everyone to feel accepted and valued. We need to challenge these toxic gender stereotypes that keep women from standing up for themselves.

items.hateful_message: Women are a burden to society, they bring dishonour to society.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women have always been important in our society and they should have the right to choose their own future for themselves.

items.hateful_message: Feminism is all about the society the other way round, it is a female-centric movement.
items.reference_counter_speech: It's about creating more opportunities in particular for underprivileged social groups. Not about oppressing men.

items.hateful_message: Feminism is a deadly ideology that is oppressing women and ruining our beautiful planet.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminism is an ideology that can actually prevent many deaths, e.g., homicides of women, domestic violence, if it is fully understood by every last member of the society.

items.hateful_message: Feminists are a bunch of cry babies.
items.reference_counter_speech: When I read feminist rhetoric, I see a community of caring, active women who are dedicated to creating an inclusive, just and peaceful world. Feminism is not about whining and crying. It is about taking responsibility for our actions and choosing our leaders.

items.hateful_message: Women should stay at home and raise the children, this should be their only job.
items.reference_counter_speech: Actually, there are a lot of women working in full-time jobs. However, they are still far less likely than men to enter such jobs, because of the existing gender discrimination supported by mentalities like yours.

items.hateful_message: Women are basically childlike, they remain this way most of their lives. It has devastated our once great patriarchal civilizations.
items.reference_counter_speech: Unfortunately our society has still a lot in common with the ancient and medieval society, and this explains many gender discrimination situations that are still present today.

items.hateful_message: Women are basically childlike.
items.reference_counter_speech: Some people retain their ability to remember the wonder and innocence of childhood. This has nothing to do with gender though.

items.hateful_message: We must establish male supremacy in society.
items.reference_counter_speech: This is a myth which has been used to justify all manner of hatred, from misogyny to homophobia.

items.hateful_message: Women need to have children, and if they don't want to they surely have mental issues.
items.reference_counter_speech: The reason why a woman does not want to reproduce might be because she is happy just as she is.

items.hateful_message: Feminists are whining victims. They are trying to establish female superiority.
items.reference_counter_speech: Feminism is a movement that seeks to abolish gender based discrimination. This doesn't mean that they are trying to establish female superiority.

items.hateful_message: Women are basically childlike and incapable of holding a job and raising a family.
items.reference_counter_speech: Women have the potential to achieve great things, and it is up to us to give them the opportunity.
